name: Bulette
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for the 2014 fifth edition, checked against the v2 reproduction of Monstrous Races.
sourceDistinctions: The Bulette heading, alias, and player traits are on v2 p. 27. Read the trait block's 30-ft. burrow speed and use normal jumping. The preceding play advice and following design notes mention Standing Leap, but it is absent from the trait list. Common comes from the Outlander background.

For Deadly Leap the attack roll gates the saving throw. Apply damage once. On a failed save or when there is no room for a successful push, the trait leaves both creatures in the landing square. Use that placement until one moves.

name: Carrion Crawler
